title: Close Section — Pre-condition Validation & Lifecycle

walkthroughSteps.title: Close Section
walkthroughSteps.body: Every section has a Close Section action in this menu. What happens next depends on whether the section has open blockers.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: With blockers present, the modal opens straight to a blocker list (Cancel-only footer). With none, it skips to a pre-closure checklist, then a closure reason — Close Section stays disabled until a reason is picked.

walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — SEC-001 has 2 hard blockers (deductible + salvage); click ⋮ → Close Section
Observe: modal opens on step 1 (Blockers) listing 2 red blocker rows, only Cancel in footer
Apply AC-02 — SEC-001 has 4 blockers (litigation + reserves + payments + provider); close modal and reopen
Observe: 4 blocker rows; expand each to see linked items/details
Apply AC-03 — SEC-001 has all blockers cleared; click ⋮ → Close Section
Observe: modal skips to step 2 (Pre-closure Checklist); Continue disabled until all 5 items checked
Check all 5 items → Continue → step 3 (Reason) → select 'Section Finalised' → Close Section
Observe: SEC-001 row status chip updates to Closed; toast confirms closure
Apply AC-04 — confirm closureDate and closureReason persisted on the section row after closure

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Section button is present on the Section page
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: A **Close Section** action is present in the section context menu (⋮). It is `disabled` — with tooltip — when the section is already `Closed`; enabled when `Open`.

setup.description: Default state — SEC-001 is Open, all blocker flags false

preconditions.text: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) is Open — context menu ⋮ shows 'Close Section' enabled
Any Closed section shows 'Close Section' disabled with tooltip 'Section already closed'

expectedUI.description: Close Section is accessible on the context menu of every Open section
visualCues: SEC-001 row: ⋮ menu → 'Close Section' is clickable
SEC-002 row (Closed): ⋮ menu → 'Close Section' is greyed out with tooltip 'Section already closed'

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ on 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) and 'Business Interruption — Machinery Sales' (SEC-002)
howToTest.expectedResult: SEC-001: Close Section enabled. SEC-002 (Closed): Close Section disabled with tooltip.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Hard blockers prevent closure — all items listed in modal step 1
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Clicking **Close Section** on a section with hard blockers opens the modal at **Step 1 — Blockers**. All blocking items are listed. The handler cannot proceed — only Cancel is available in the footer.

setup.description: SEC-001 given 3 hard blockers: deductible, litigation, reserves. Modal must show all 3 on step 1.

preconditions.text: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) is Open with deductible, litigation, and reserves blockers
3 red blocker rows visible; only Cancel in footer

expectedUI.description: Modal step 1 showing 3 blocker rows; no Continue or Close Section button
visualCues: Modal title: 'Close Section — Blockers'
Blocker: 'Open Manage Deductible task must be closed'
Blocker: 'Active litigation assignment must be resolved'
Blocker: 'Pending reserves must be released'
Footer: only Cancel button

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001)
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal step 1 shows 3 blocker rows; only Cancel available

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All 7 hard blockers are individually recognised
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Each of the 7 hard blocker types produces a distinct row in the modal when set. All 7 flags together produce 7 rows.

setup.description: All 7 blocker flags set true on SEC-001

preconditions.text: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) has all 7 blocker flags set

expectedUI.description: Modal step 1 with all 7 blocker types
visualCues: Blocker: 'Open Manage Deductible task must be closed'
Blocker: 'Active litigation assignment must be resolved'
Blocker: 'Pending subrogation activity must be resolved'
Blocker: 'Pending salvage activity must be resolved'
Blocker: 'Pending reserves must be released'
Blocker: 'Pending payments must be settled'
Blocker: 'Active provider assignment must be finalised'
Footer: only Cancel button

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001)
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal step 1 shows 7 distinct blocker rows; only Cancel available

acceptanceCriteria.statement: No blockers — modal proceeds to pre-closure checklist then reason
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When **no blockers** exist the modal **skips step 1** and opens at **Step 2 — Pre-closure Checklist**. The handler must tick all 5 items to enable Continue, then select a mandatory closure reason on step 3.

setup.description: All blocker flags cleared on SEC-001; modal opens at checklist

preconditions.text: Modal opens directly at 'Close Section — Pre-closure Checklist'
Continue is disabled until all 5 checkboxes are ticked
Step 3 shows a mandatory Closure Reason dropdown

expectedUI.description: Step 2 checklist, then step 3 reason dropdown; no blocker step shown
visualCues: Modal title: 'Close Section — Pre-closure Checklist'
5 checkboxes — all pre-checked by default
Untick any item → Continue becomes disabled
Step 3: 'Closure reason' dropdown required (Section Finalised / Section Not Pursued / Section Rejected)
Close Section button disabled until reason selected

howToTest.trigger: Click ⋮ → Close Section on 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001)
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal opens at checklist (step 2); Continue disabled if any checkbox unticked; step 3 requires reason

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Confirming closure sets status to Closed and persists closureDate
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: After selecting a reason and clicking **Close Section**, the section row updates to `Closed` and `closureDate` is persisted. If this was the last open section on the claim, the app navigates to the claim overview.

setup.description: All blocker flags cleared on SEC-001; handler completes checklist and selects reason

preconditions.text: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) row status chip changes to 'Closed' after confirmation
closureDate is today's date; closedBy is the current user

expectedUI.description: Section row updates to Closed after modal confirmed
visualCues: SEC-001 row status chip → 'Closed' (grey)
Toast success: 'Section SEC-001 closed' with closure reason subtitle
Close Section context menu item now disabled with tooltip 'Section already closed'
If last open section → app navigates to /claims/CLM-2024-001/overview

howToTest.trigger: Complete the 3-step modal (no blockers → checklist all ticked → reason 'Section Finalised') and click Close Section
howToTest.expectedResult: SEC-001 chip → Closed; toast fires; closureDate set to today; if last open section, nav to overview
